tensor.fill_granularity: one uniform scalar per tensor; not elementwise data coverage

scalar.floating: 256 byte-derived points in finite specified interval; degenerate interval is fixed
scalar.integer: multi-byte modulo into specified signed int64 interval; not distribution-uniform

interpretation: Resource bounds, not API facts. Exact same policy must be referenced by paired baseline/static plans. This policy does not promise exhaustive input coverage.
